delivery_note: This is the feed only. Per-user watchlists and delivery need the account layer, which is dormant. Nothing is emailed or pushed from this artifact.
floor_note: 50 of 100 rows have an eFV 20 endpoint, which is the model floor: the player entered or left the graded pool rather than being re-graded. Those two event types share the feed (floor transitions are capped at 50 percent of the slots) because ranking on absolute move alone gave them every slot. Filter on at_floor to split them again.
